The CLI only renders what the router decided (no re-ranking, no re-derived suggestion); the JSON emitter is byte-identical in keys and stderr destination, so the machine contract is unchanged. Colours are escaped before rich sees request text, and the remedy line is soft-wrapped so the --profile command stays copy-pasteable.
